title: Feedback page
summary: Tell us what you think, report a bug or suggest an idea, right from the site.

changes.text: Feedback page: read what other travelers think of GI Helper and post your own, with an optional name.
Your name starts as a random Genshin character's, with their avatar next to it. Roll the dice for another character, or type your own name and keep the avatar.

Send feedback, a bug report, an idea or anything else from one form, with up to 3 screenshots. Paste a screenshot straight in with Ctrl+V. Bug reports, ideas and other messages stay private; only feedback is posted on the page.
Screenshots are shrunk in your browser before they're sent, which also strips location data from photos.
Bad words are masked in names and messages, and the form warns you before you send.
A Feedback link in the footer and on the About page, and a note on how feedback is stored under Your data.
